propositions: The review-bot service must be reconfigured to route its LLM calls through Bedrock inference profiles (opus for Pass-1, sonnet for Pass-2/Pass-4, haiku for trivial) instead of direct Anthropic API.
The review-bot container image must install the bedrock extra for pydantic-ai-slim so the BedrockProvider module is available at runtime.

The kill switch (reverting to Anthropic) must be proven operational before the cutover takes effect, including a demonstrated VOTER_ERROR on the pre-cutover Anthropic path and a working recovery path that does not depend on fetching new credentials.

A CloudWatch alarm must exist and be actively evaluating real Bedrock traffic (not INSUFFICIENT_DATA) to detect Bedrock client-error rates exceeding 25% over a 15-minute window before the cutover merges.

Every LLM call in production post-cutover must reach a Bedrock inference profile (zero direct-Anthropic calls), and the per-pass model split (frontier→opus, standard/trivial→sonnet/haiku) must be observable in usage logs and code-review sidecar provenance.
